summary: Import preserves playable Agent meaning into canonical fields. Foundry sheet knobs and document metadata are residual extensions or intentionally ignored. Enumerated losses cover schema gaps and init-sentinel collisions.

losses.loss: Delta Green 1.7.0 persists Unarmed Combat as a standard skill key, but canonical Agent 1.0.0 has no unarmedCombat standard skill id. Rating is preserved as a custom skill (group unarmed_combat, label Unarmed Combat).
losses.remediation: Accept custom skill, or later amend canonical schema and remap.

losses.loss: Foundry treats sanity.value >= 100 as an initialization sentinel and rewrites it to POW×5 on prepare. Import cannot distinguish an intentional SAN ≥ 100 from the blank-Actor sentinel; values ≥ 100 are normalized to POW×5.
losses.remediation: Keep SAN below 100 for explicit currents; unusual high SAN cannot round-trip through Foundry prepare.

losses.loss: Foundry persists only currentBreakingPoint. Baseline is taken from adapter flags when present, else derived (SAN−POW when consistent) or copied from current with a warning.
losses.remediation: Export capability writes baseline into flags.deltaGreenCharacterAdapter.unrepresentable when it must be retained.

losses.loss: DG 1.7.0 Agent schema has no general notes fields. notes.player and notes.handler import empty. Handler text on tomes/rituals maps onto those inventory entries only.
losses.remediation: Carry notes via canonical from other adapters; Foundry export parks unrepresentable notes in module flags.

losses.loss: Foundry only models violence and helplessness incident bits. kind=other adaptations cannot originate from this source.
losses.remediation: other adaptations may exist in canonical from other adapters; they are not read from Foundry adaptation fields.

losses.loss: Canonical weapon schema has no isLethal or customSkillTarget fields. Values are retained under extensions.foundry for correlation only and are not Agent meaning for other adapters.
losses.remediation: Export may re-derive isLethal from lethality > 0 when writing Foundry.

losses.loss: Foundry document and local collection ids are not durable canonical identities unless an adapter flag already binds a UUID. New UUID v4 values are generated when unbound.
Foundry-owned presentation, access, ActiveEffects, and other-module flags are not Agent interchange meaning and are omitted from canonical.
losses.remediation: Merge paths preserve them on the Actor; they are not transported through canonical.

losses.loss: Non-digit age strings cannot populate canonical non-negative int age. Original text is preserved in extensions.foundry.raw.
losses.remediation: Correct age to a digit string in Foundry or set biography.age after import.

notLosses: Impossible Landscapes corruption fields map into campaignState.impossibleLandscapes.
Exact violence/helplessness incident marks are preserved (unlike GAC import).
Sheet settings, schemaVersion, resource min, and exhaustedPenalty retained under extensions.foundry.sheet.
DOB and aliases recovered from module flags into canonical fields when present.
Prepared projections ignored rather than treated as conflicting source facts.
Out-of-range stats/skills warned but not silently clamped.
System-owned Unarmed Attack weapon is imported as inventory.weapons[] with identity correlation.
